Alexandra Chen  
Staff QA Engineer – Test Automation Architect | AdVerve Technologies  
📍 Berlin, Germany | [LinkedIn](https://linkedin.com/in/alexandra-chen) | [GitHub](https://github.com/alexandrac)  

**Professional Summary**  
10+ years of experience in adtech QA engineering, specializing in test automation architecture, CI/CD pipelines, and API testing. Proven ability to design scalable test frameworks, reduce regression time by 40%, and drive cross-functional collaboration. Focused on delivering robust, maintainable automation solutions that align with enterprise-grade adtech systems.  

**AdVerve Technologies | Staff QA Engineer**  
*2019 – Present*  
- Spearheaded test automation architecture for ad-serving platforms, reducing manual regression time by 40% through Python-based test frameworks and Playwright integration.  
- Designed CI/CD pipelines using GitLab CI and Jenkins, enabling 100% automated testing for 80% of feature branches, with 95% faster feedback loops.  
- Led API testing strategy for ad inventory APIs, implementing RESTful best practices and mentoring 3 junior engineers on API mocking and validation.  
- Built performance testing infrastructure with k6 and JMeter, identifying bottlenecks in ad latency, resulting in 25% improvement in ad load times.  
- Collaborated with DevOps to integrate test results into monitoring dashboards, improving defect detection rates by 30% across ad campaign modules.  
- Architected integration testing for ad verification workflows, ensuring compliance with GDPR and IAB standards, with zero critical production issues in 18 months.  

**ClickFlow Media | Senior QA Engineer**  
*2016 – 2019*  
- Developed end-to-end test automation for ad tracking systems, reducing deployment risks by 50% and enabling 100% automated regression for core ad metrics.  
- Pioneered Python-based test scripts for ad campaign validation, achieving 90% test coverage for ad creative validation workflows.  
- Designed CI/CD pipelines with Docker and Kubernetes, streamlining deployment processes and reducing environment setup time by 60%.  
- Mentored 2 QA leads on test strategy design, resulting in standardized test frameworks adopted across 3 product lines.  
- Implemented performance testing for ad-serving APIs, identifying and resolving 15+ critical latency issues, improving ad delivery speed by 20%.  

**AdSquared Inc | QA Lead**  
*2013 – 2016*  
- Led a team of 5 QA engineers to build a modular test automation framework, reducing test script maintenance costs by 35%.  
- Architected integration testing for ad exchange platforms, ensuring seamless data flow between ad networks and analytics tools, with 0 production outages.  
- Designed REST API testing protocols for ad bidding systems, aligning with IAB standards and improving API reliability by 40%.  
- Established CI/CD practices for ad campaign tools, reducing deployment delays by 50% and enabling nightly automated testing for all features.  
- Resolved critical performance issues in ad load balancing, increasing system throughput by 30% during peak traffic periods.  

**MediaNet Solutions | QA Engineer**  
*2010 – 2013*  
- Developed test automation for ad targeting systems, achieving 85% test coverage and reducing manual testing hours by 50%.  
- Built Python scripts for ad campaign validation, streamlining data verification processes and improving reporting accuracy by 25%.  
- Collaborated with developers to implement CI/CD for ad management tools, reducing deployment cycles from 5 days to 2 hours.

*University of California, Berkeley*  
Bachelor of Science in Computer Science | 2012
